# Issue

**Title:** Add a link to download full tabular data as CSV

## Description

This PR adds a link to download tabular data as CSV. This uses a bit of hack to build out the download link by utilizing data URIs: https://discuss.streamlit.io/t/how-to-download-file-in-streamlit/1806/2

Closes

## Task

Modify the repository so that the issue described above is resolved. The repository is checked out at base commit `28304a6a8cd3`. Edit files in place; the verifier captures your changes via `git diff` and scores them against an oracle patch using SWE-RL-style diff-similarity reward.
